description.value: Prince Chinese Seafood Restaurant (王子海鮮酒家) is a full-service Chinese seafood restaurant on Grandview Highway in East Vancouver, offering dim sum, dinner service, and banquet facilities. The restaurant operates in a smoke-free indoor environment with no outdoor seating. It sits along a major east-west arterial route and could serve as a meal stop for cyclists, though no cycling-specific amenities have been confirmed.
